description: Vetted clause fragments for the Custom OPL configurator. The configurator assembles a license ONLY from these fragments (parameterized, never free-form). Each fragment has a stable id, a slot it fills, and allowed parameter values.

paid_standard_terms.desc: Commercial Use requires payment per Maintainer's published Standard Terms URL (base OPL-1.4 behavior).

free_for_all.desc: No payment required for any use; license behaves like a permissive source-available license.

personal_only.desc: Only Personal Use is permitted; all commercial use prohibited (most restrictive).

off.desc: No scheduled conversion. Pure fair-source; converts to Apache 2.0 only on abandonment (if at all).

months.desc: Scheduled conversion to Apache 2.0 N months after each Version's release. N is any positive integer (recommended 24-60; longer allowed).

forever_frozen.desc: No conversion ever. Code stays source-available permanently. NOT Fair Source.

convert_apache.desc: After abandonment period of unresponsiveness, Work converts to Apache 2.0 (base behavior).

freeze_forever.desc: On abandonment, code stays source-available; no conversion. NOT Fair Source.

custom_period.desc: Abandonment period set to a custom value (12-60 months).

in.desc: OPL-AI addendum incorporated; AI training restricted.

changeable.desc: Maintainer may change commercial terms with notice.

immutable_per_version.desc: Commercial terms immutable per Version (binding COMMERCIAL_TERMS.md).

light_copyleft.desc: Derivatives must carry OPL/compatible notice (base behavior).

free_text.desc: Adopter declares any governing jurisdiction in NOTICE. No curated list.

hard_blocks: dosp:forever_frozen + fair_source_label = BLOCK (a no-conversion variant is NOT Fair Source)
commercial_model:personal_only + dosp:months = WARN (a personal-only work gaining DOSP is unusual but allowed)
